'''Allian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who served on the [[Alderaanian gunship]] [[Aegis (Alderaanian gunship)|''Aegis'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Allian, along with the rest of the ''Aegis'' crew, turned to [[Pirate|piracy]].
